eligibility.Eligibility Rationale: The study uses a non‑linear machine learning model (MLP) to predict primary graft dysfunction in adult heart transplant recipients, includes relevant outcomes and is a peer‑reviewed article published after 2018.

identification_methods.Comments: Retrospective analysis of UNOS heart transplant data to predict primary graft dysfunction using machine learning.
identification_methods.Address: 400 Bizzell St, College Station, TX 77840, United States
identification_methods.Identification Notes: Excluded patients with multiple transplants and features with >40% missing; generated donor-recipient pair features; total 66 features used.
identification_methods.AI Model Architecture: Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) with comparisons to logistic regression, GBDT, Decision Tree, LightGBM, SVM
identification_methods.Comparator: Logistic regression, GBDT, Decision Tree, LightGBM, SVM
identification_methods.Input Variables: 66 donor and recipient demographic, clinical, laboratory, and procedural features including pairwise attributes.
identification_methods.Methods Notes: Feature attribution using Integrated Gradients; interaction analysis; performance evaluated by AUROC and AUPRC.

population.Exclusion criteria: Patients with multiple transplants during index hospitalization; features with >40% missing rate
population.Population Notes: Cohort curated from United Network for Organ Sharing (UNOS) database

interventions_outcomes.Intervention Input Data Modality: Tabular donor and recipient clinical variables
interventions_outcomes.Feature Selection Method: Expert domain knowledge filtering and removal of features with >40% missingness
interventions_outcomes.Interventions Notes: Categorical encoding, kNN imputation for missing data, 5‑fold cross‑validation
interventions_outcomes.Reported outcomes in study: Prediction of primary graft dysfunction (PGD) with AUROC and AUPRC
interventions_outcomes.Outcomes Notes: Primary focus on area under the ROC curve (AUROC)
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Reported against: Logistic regression, SVM, GBDT, Decision Tree, LightGBM
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Metric Definition: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve on held‑out test folds
interventions_outcomes.Primary Outcome Notes: ML model predicts early PGD with high discrimination
